name: customer-care-rag-seed
description: Starter RAG evaluation set for bank customer-care staff. Replace source titles with the bank's approved uploaded document titles before using this as a release gate.

cases.question: What must customer care verify before helping a customer with account information?
When should a debit card dispute be escalated, and which team handles it?
Which documents should staff request when a customer wants to update KYC details?
What is the required timeline for registering and acknowledging a customer complaint?
What is the approved customer-care process for a crypto staking account?
